audit.failClosed: Empty target, missing consent, inaccessible target, primary, nonowner, wrong returned calendar ID, lookup exception, empty stored event ID or event absent in selected calendar all fail before mutate_ sets pending guard or changes sheet/calendar.
audit.pendingGuard: withLock_ checks existing PENDING_MUTATION_JSON before handlers; new preflight occurs inside that lock and before mutate_. Event creation uncertainty, cancellation irreversible deletion, rollback, guard retention and lock release remain covered by prior fault tests.
audit.replay: Existing identical reservation replay and already-cancelled replay remain side-effect free and do not require new Calendar lookup. They do not prove remote event presence. New writes require validated target.
audit.eventResolution: Cancellation uses only ledger stored event ID in the selected calendar; no date search, supplied event ID or default calendar fallback. Legacy unresolved rows remain unchanged and require operator reconciliation.
audit.regression: All prior 70 cases plus 4 new calendar-target cases pass independently. Student/purchase/complete/auth/portal/account handling and 8/12/7 schemas unchanged in reviewed patch.
audit.scope: calendar is a documented supported write scope for the current CalendarApp implementation; it remains account-wide OAuth authority. Runtime target checks restrict application behavior, not the OAuth grant. No claim that this is the only possible scope design.
